snippet.title: Broken Sword Collection - Evercade Cartridge Tour
snippet.description:
Captured off the Evercade VS.
This is the third Giga cart for Evercade, which means it's big enough to fit in multiple PS1 games. This cart has PS1 ports of Broken Sword 1 and 2.

Games on the cart:
00:00:33 - Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars
00:52:24 - Broken Sword II: The Smoking Mirror

Broken Sword (C) Revolution Software
